These routes of the platform API come from its [OpenAPI document](../openapi.json); [The REST API as a contract](../rest-api.md) says what Lakana promises about them.

## `POST /api/v1/environments/{env}/namespaces/{path}/artifacts/{name}/uploads`

Begin an artifact upload

Checks a manifest of files and opens an upload for the next version of an artifact; the artifact is created on first use. The answer names the files the store does not have yet: send those with the blob route, then commit. Needs `WRITE_TABLE` on the name, and `CREATE_TABLE` as well to create the artifact. Answers 404 when the namespace does not exist, 409 when the artifact has too many open uploads or when a person would create an artifact under a name a deployed project declares, 413 for a manifest over the server's limit, 408 when the body arrives too slowly, 503 when the server is busy (try again after `Retry-After`) and 422 when the body is not a manifest or breaks one of its rules.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `path` | path | yes | text | Dot-joined namespace path. |
| `name` | path | yes | text | Artifact name. |
| `break_glass_reason` | query | no | text or null | Why the protection of a protected environment is broken, up to 500 characters; recorded in the audit log. Only a protected environment needs it. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Successful Response | `ArtifactUploadOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `409` | The request conflicts with the current state; the message says what to change. | `ErrorOut` |
| `408` | No part of the request body arrived within the read timeout. | `ErrorOut` |
| `413` | The request body is larger than the server accepts. | `ErrorOut` |
| `503` | The server cannot do this right now; ask again after the time in `Retry-After`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `ArtifactUploadOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `upload_id` | text | yes |  |
| `missing` | list of text | yes |  |
| `expires_at` | text (date-time) | yes |  |

## `PUT /api/v1/environments/{env}/namespaces/{path}/artifacts/{name}/uploads/{upload_id}/blobs/{sha256}`

Upload one file of an artifact

Receives one file of an open upload as the request body and checks it against the manifest's size and SHA-256. Needs `WRITE_TABLE`. Answers 409 when the upload has expired, was committed or does not exist, 422 when the file is longer or shorter than declared, its hash differs, or the manifest names no file with this hash, 400 when the client closed the connection part-way, 408 when the body arrives too slowly and 503 when the server is busy (try again after `Retry-After`).

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `path` | path | yes | text | Dot-joined namespace path. |
| `name` | path | yes | text | Artifact name. |
| `upload_id` | path | yes | text (uuid) | The upload's id, as returned when it was begun. |
| `sha256` | path | yes | text | The file's SHA-256, 64 lower-case hexadecimal digits. |
| `break_glass_reason` | query | no | text or null | Why the protection of a protected environment is broken, up to 500 characters; recorded in the audit log. Only a protected environment needs it. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `ArtifactBlobOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |

## `POST /api/v1/environments/{env}/namespaces/{path}/artifacts/{name}/uploads/{upload_id}/commit`

Commit an artifact upload

Turns a complete upload into the artifact's next version. Needs `WRITE_TABLE`. Answers 409 when the upload expired, was committed already or does not exist, or files of it are not stored yet; 404 when a source the version names does not exist; 422 when a source is malformed.

## `DELETE /api/v1/environments/{env}/namespaces/{path}/artifacts/{name}/uploads/{upload_id}`

Withdraw an upload

Withdraws an upload that was begun and will not be finished. Only the caller that began it (for a task, the same attempt) can, and only while it is open. Files it stored stay until the periodic clean-up. Answers 403 with one text whether or not the artifact or upload exists, 404 when the caller may write the name and no artifact has it, 409 for an upload that does not exist, is another caller's, expired or was committed, and 422 when the name belongs to a table or a view.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `path` | path | yes | text | Dot-joined namespace path. |
| `name` | path | yes | text | Artifact name. |
| `upload_id` | path | yes | text (uuid) | The upload's id, as returned when it was begun. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Successful Response | none |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `409` | The request conflicts with the current state; the message says what to change. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

## `DELETE /api/v1/environments/{env}/namespaces/{path}/artifacts/{name}/versions/{version}`

Delete one version of an artifact

From the web interface it needs a passkey touch within the last 15 minutes (403 `StepUpRequired`); a token never does.

Deletes the bytes of one version; its record and its lineage stay. Needs `DROP_TABLE` on the name; a task token is always refused, and in a protected environment a reason for breaking the protection is needed. The version is gone for every reader when this answers. Large versions are removed in part by this request and in part by the server's periodic clean-up. The answer says how many files and bytes were freed and how many stayed, with the reason. Answers 403 with one text whether or not the artifact or version exists, 404 when the caller may drop the name and the artifact or version is absent, 409 when the version is deleted already and 422 when the version is not a positive number or the name is not an artifact.

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |

| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `path` | path | yes | text | Dot-joined namespace path. |
| `name` | path | yes | text | Artifact name. |
| `version` | path | yes | text | The version number: a positive number, not ``current``. |
| `break_glass_reason` | query | no | text or null | Why the protection of a protected environment is broken, up to 500 characters; recorded in the audit log. Only a protected environment needs it. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |

## `DELETE /api/v1/environments/{env}/namespaces/{path}/artifacts/{name}`

Drop an artifact

From the web interface it needs a passkey touch within the last 15 minutes (403 `StepUpRequired`); a token never does.

Removes the artifact with all its versions' bytes, its rows and its grants. This cannot be undone. Needs `DROP_TABLE` on the name; a task token is always refused, and in a protected environment a reason for breaking the protection is needed. An artifact with thousands of files takes a while; if the server fails part-way, its periodic clean-up finishes the job. Answers 403 with one text whether or not the artifact exists, 404 when the caller may drop the name and no artifact has it, 409 when a deployed project produces the artifact (remove the asset in git and deploy, or delete single versions) or when the storage could not be written (nothing was deleted), and 422 when the name belongs to a table or a view.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `path` | path | yes | text | Dot-joined namespace path. |
| `name` | path | yes | text | Artifact name. |
| `break_glass_reason` | query | no | text or null | Why the protection of a protected environment is broken, up to 500 characters; recorded in the audit log. Only a protected environment needs it. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Successful Response | none |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `409` | The request conflicts with the current state; the message says what to change. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

## `GET /api/v1/environments/{env}/namespaces/{path}/artifacts/{name}/versions/{version}/blobs/{sha256}`

Download one file of an artifact version

Streams the file as `application/octet-stream` with its size as `Content-Length`; the download is audited. Needs `READ_TABLE` on the name. Answers 403 with one text whether or not the artifact, version or file exists, 404 when the caller may read the name and the version, file or its bytes are absent or the version was deleted, 422 for a malformed version or hash, and 503 when too many files are being sent or storage could not be opened (try again after `Retry-After`).

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `path` | path | yes | text | Dot-joined namespace path. |
| `name` | path | yes | text | Artifact name. |
| `version` | path | yes | text | A positive number (not ``current``). |
| `sha256` | path | yes | text | The file's SHA-256, 64 lower-case hexadecimal digits. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `application/octet-stream` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `503` | The server cannot do this right now; ask again after the time in `Retry-After`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

## `GET /api/v1/environments/{env}/artifacts/uploads`

List your open uploads

Lists the open uploads the caller began in the environment, newest first; for a task, those of its own attempt. Other principals' uploads are never listed and nothing says they exist. An upload that was begun and never finished holds one of its artifact's upload places until it expires; the answer gives the id that the withdraw route needs. Needs `READ_ENVIRONMENT`. Answers 404 when the environment does not exist and 422 for a `name` that is not `namespace.name` or a `cursor` this server did not issue.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `name` | query | no | text or null | Only this artifact, as ``namespace.name``. |
| `limit` | query | no | whole number | Most uploads in the page (1 to 500). |
| `cursor` | query | no | text or null | A previous page's `next_cursor`, to fetch the page after it. The same `name` must be sent with every page. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `ArtifactUploadPage` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `ArtifactUploadPage`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | list of `ArtifactUploadItemOut` | yes |  |
| `next_cursor` | text or null | yes |  |

## `GET /api/v1/environments/{env}/artifacts`

List the artifacts of an environment, one page at a time

Lists the artifacts of the environment that the caller may read. A caller who may read the environment but no artifact gets an empty list, so that an empty list reveals nothing. Needs `READ_ENVIRONMENT`. Answers 404 when the environment does not exist and 422 when the namespace path is malformed or the cursor is not one this list issued. The cursor of the next page is in the `X-Next-Cursor` response header and is absent on the last page.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `namespace` | query | no | text or null | Only this dot-joined namespace path. |
| `limit` | query | no | whole number | Most artifacts returned (1 to 200). |
| `cursor` | query | no | text or null | The `X-Next-Cursor` of the previous page; send the same `namespace`. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | list of `ArtifactOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |
